results.proposed_sentence: The Kuwait Electrosurgical Generators Market grows at 7.5% a year through 2032, while unit sales grow at 5.5%, lifting revenue per unit by about 1.9% a year. Procurement could be uneven around that trend.
results.insertion_marker: Service and instrument demand follows installations, case volumes and platform-specific purchasing, so revenue from a new operating room is realized over several budget cycles.

results.proposed_sentence: For comparison, the Mexico Pharmaceutical Logistics Market reaches about USD 3.5 billion by 2032, growing at 7.5% a year. Most of that increase comes from higher shipment and handling activity rather than pricing.
results.insertion_marker: Project commissioning alone does not establish future occupied capacity or contracted revenue.

results.proposed_sentence: The Kuwait Genetic Testing Market doubles from USD 22 million to USD 44 million by 2032, growing at 10.4% a year. Clinical diagnostic genetics rises from 37% to 42% of its modelled service mix.
results.insertion_marker: Growth depends on affordability and clinical execution; insurance expansion, major new facilities and exceptional inbound patient inflows are not necessary assumptions in the base case.
